prompt: Create a photorealistic high-angle smartphone selfie of an adult East Asian woman in a bright modern bedroom, looking directly into the camera with a soft friendly smile. She has warm light brown hair styled in a loose low side bun with wispy bangs and face-framing strands, natural glowy makeup, brown eyes, and smooth skin. She wears a fitted cream white ribbed spaghetti-strap crop tank top, an open sheer white button-up shirt, a delicate thin necklace with a tiny pearl pendant, and high-waisted blue denim shorts. The camera is held above her at arm’s length with a wide-angle phone perspective, creating a casual selfie composition with her upper body centered and one extended arm visible in the foreground. Background: soft daylight bedroom interior with neutral walls, wardrobe doors with dark handles on the left, a bed with white bedding on the right, a mirror or glass panel edge, and gray carpet. Lighting is natural window light, bright and flattering, with shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, subtle fabric translucency in the overshirt, crisp details, and no text or watermark. Use a vertical 3:4 portrait frame, candid social-media photo style, polished but not over-edited.
